headline: Why our model likes Toronto
caption:
One factor did most of the work on this pick. 👀

The biggest push came from tonight's players: who is actually suiting up moved our model 4.1 points toward Toronto. Recent point differential added another 3.9, and team efficiency nudged it 0.3 more.

Add it up and the model picks the Raptors at 81% at home against the Bulls. That's a strong lean, not a lock: Chicago still wins this one 19% of the time.

Does Toronto handle business tonight, or do the Bulls steal one?
